decision.what: Approvals are read by the browser from each session's own session.jsonl, not from the day index.json
decision.why: closed day files are frozen (AISessionIndex never rewrites them) and leaks are by definition over a day old, so the index could never carry a later approval
decision.alternative: add approve to AISession.record() so open days' snapshots carry it; rejected for this slice, it would only cover today
